description: add of an address whose entry the target config already holds but config load refuses (k116) – a hand-written `ref: ""` in the user config, `ref: "-x"` in the project's, an unknown key – exits 1 quoting load's error for that file and the ways out, before anything is trusted or synced; an entry written as null or as an array has no address, so the name counts as taken by another: `is null`, `is ["…"]`. Nothing written, no lock.
